;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Darfur]]; [[Sudanese conflict in South Kordofan and Blue Nile]]
**A [[peace deal]] is signed between [[Sudan]]'s transitional government and the [[Sudan Revolutionary Front]] in [[South Sudan]]'s capital [[Juba]], raising hopes of peace after nearly 18 years of [[civil war]]s in the country. According to the agreement, the [[States of Sudan|states]] [[Blue Nile (state)|Blue Nile]], [[South Kordofan]], and [[West Kordofan]] will be granted [[self-rule]]. The deal does not, however, include two major belligerent groups, the [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-North|SPLM–N]] and [[Sudan Liberation Movement/Army|SLM/A]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-signs-landmark-peace-deal-with-rebel-alliance/a-54770720 (DW)]
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]], [[Gaza–Israel clashes in 2020]]
**[[Palestinian territories|Palestinian]] militant group [[Hamas]] announces that a [[ceasefire]] agreement has been reached with the [[Israeli government]] to end a month-long series of cross-border firing involving the launch of [[incendiary balloon]]s in the [[Gaza Strip]]. The agreement follows mediation talks with [[Government of Egypt|Egypt]]ian and [[Government of Qatar|Qatar]]i officials. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/aug/31/hamas-and-israel-agree-end-to-cross-border-bombing-in-gaza (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reports that 11 people, including one civilian, are killed by [[airstrike]]s allegedly carried out by the [[Israel Defense Forces]] near [[Damascus]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/report-from-syria-attacks-on-damascus-640649 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Korean Wave]]
**[[South Korea]]n boy band [[BTS]] become the first all-South Korean act to top the United States [[record chart]], after their single "[[Dynamite (BTS song)|Dynamite]]" debuted at number one on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] chart. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2020/sep/01/bts-k-pop-stars-become-first-all-south-korean-act-to-top-us-singles-charts (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
**[[Economy of India|India's economy]] contracts by 23.9% in the April–June quarter, the country's worst [[recession]] on record since the [[Government of India|government]] started releasing quarterly data in 1996. The [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in India|lockdown]] caused massive disruptions to economic activity during the quarter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-asia-india-53973772 (BBC News)] [https://www.bloombergquint.com/business/india-gdp-contracts-a-record-239-in-april-june-quarter (Bloomberg Quint)]
*[[Argentine debt restructuring]]
**[[Argentina]] announces a deal with its creditors, allowing a way out of its ninth [[sovereign default]]. [https://www.irishtimes.com/business/economy/argentina-defuses-default-crisis-with-massive-debt-deal-1.4343629 (''Irish Times'')]
*[[Amazon Prime Air]] wins [[Federal Aviation Administration]] approval to operate a [[Amazon Prime Air|drone delivery service]] in the [[United States]]. Amazon becomes the third drone delivery service to win flight approval, after [[United Parcel Service|UPS]] and [[Wing (company)|Wing]]. [https://apnews.com/e1480f2cdc2700c45f8b5c53ccd6d0f3 (AP)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two explosions in the [[United Arab Emirates]] kill three people and injure several others. One of the explosions occurred in [[Abu Dhabi]] and the other in [[Dubai]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-emirates-restaurant-blast/three-killed-several-hurt-in-two-uae-restaurant-blasts-idUSKBN25R103?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 wildfire season]]
**Over 8,000 acres are burnt and one house destroyed after a scrub fire grows out of control near [[New Zealand]]'s [[Lake Pukaki]], requiring the evacuation of [[Mount Cook Village]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/122610766/policeled-convoys-lead-campers-to-safety-through-lake-pukaki-fire-zone (Stuff)]
*The death toll from the [[floods]] across [[Italy]] rise to seven people, as heavy rains affects more cities. Many more injuries and some missing are reported. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/maltempo_oggi_brennero_lazio_roma_ultime_notizie_morti_ultima_ora-5434102.html (''Il Messaggero'')] [https://www.fanpage.it/attualita/maltempo-temporali-flagellano-il-nord-italia-1-morto-crolla-muro-su-3-persone-e-alberi-abbattuti/ (Fanpage)] [https://www.teleclubitalia.it/203182/campania-maltempo-killer-incidente-sulla-statale-provoca-due-morti-e-due-feriti/ (Teleclub Italia)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]]
*****[[List of governors of Mississippi|Mississippi Governor]] [[Tate Reeves]] extends the state's [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] to two weeks. [https://www.meridianstar.com/news/reeves-extends-mask-mandate-loosens-restrictions-on-school-activities/article_5ab5e704-eb9f-11ea-af78-47f0595d3a7e.html (''The Meridian Star'')]
****The United States surpasses six million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/08/31/health/us-coronavirus-monday/index.html (CNN)]
****[[AstraZeneca]] begins [[Phases of clinical research#Phase III|Phase III clinical trials]] of its potential [[COVID-19 vaccine]], AZD1222, which it developed with the [[University of Oxford]], to some 30,000 adults in the United States. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-08-31/astrazeneca-u-s-vaccine-trial-starts-after-delay-hospital-says (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[Maryland]]-based vaccine development company [[Novavax]] signs a deal with [[Canada]] to supply up to 76 million doses of its COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/novavax-covid-19-vaccine-1.5706067 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****The [[Ministry of Social Affairs and Health]] launches a [[COVID-19 apps|digital contact tracing app]] in an effort to combat the spread of COVID-19 in [[Finland|the country]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/finland-launches-its-own-coronavirus-tracing-app-13069224 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
****[[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] voices concerns after 160 more people tested positive for COVID-19 in [[Scotland]] in the last 24 hours, a three-month high. She says the rise in cases was "partly the result of a greater number of people being tested", but it is "undoubtedly a concern" and that any connection between cases is being "carefully considered" by health protection teams. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/uk-scotland-53971946 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reports 41 new deaths, including eight people who died in the last 24 hours. The other 33 were reported before yesterday, which includes 22 people who died in the weeks leading up to August 27 and were reported to DHHS by aged care facilities on August 30. [https://amp.9news.com.au/article/9c373040-8fe8-4697-af0c-dc607300c080 (9News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] extends the [[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines#General community quarantine (GCQ)|general community quarantine]] on [[Metro Manila]] until the end of September, while placing the provinces of [[Batangas]] and [[Bulacan]] and the cities of [[Bacolod]] and [[Tacloban]] under the same level of the eased quarantine protocol; meanwhile, the city of [[Iligan]] is placed under [[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines#Enhanced community quarantine (ECQ)|modified enhanced community quarantine]], the most stringent lockdown measure. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-08-31/philippines-extends-partial-coronavirus-curbs-in-manila-until-sept-30 (Reuters via U.S. News)] [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-08/31/c_139332285.htm (Xinhua)] [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2020/8/31/new-quarantine-classifications-september-1.html (CNN Philippines)]

;International relations
*[[Israel–United Arab Emirates peace agreement]], [[Israel–United Arab Emirates relations]], [[Israel–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Israel]]i [[flag carrier]] [[El Al]] launches the first [[Direct flight|direct]] [[Commercial aviation|commercial flight]] between Israel and the [[United Arab Emirates]] following the normalization of relations between the two countries. The inaugural flight, which transported high-level delegations from Israel and the United States from [[Tel Aviv]] to [[Abu Dhabi]], flew over [[Saudi Arabia]]n airspace for the first time by an Israeli commercial aircraft. High-level officials on the flight include [[Senior Advisor to the President of the United States|Senior Advisor to the U.S. President]] [[Jared Kushner]], [[National Security Advisor (United States)|U.S. National Security Advisor]] [[Robert C. O'Brien]], and Israeli National Security Advisor Meir Ben-Shabbat. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/flight-israeli-plane-heads-uae-saudi-arabia-200831070159156.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Aftermath of the [[2020 Belarusian presidential election]], [[Belarus–Estonia relations]], [[Belarus–Latvia relations]], [[Belarus–Lithuania relations]]
**The governments of the [[Baltic states]] declare [[Belarus]]ian [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] and 29 other [[Government of Belarus|government]] officials ''[[persona non grata]]'' for suspected [[electoral fraud]] in the recent election and for attempting to suppress the [[2020 Belarusian protests|protests]] responding to the election. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1329473/baltic-states-impose-sanctions-against-belarus-ahead-of-eu (AP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[France–Lebanon relations]], [[2019–20 Lebanese protests]], aftermath of the [[2020 Beirut explosion]]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] visits [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], for the second time since the explosion to urge [[Politics of Lebanon|politicians]] to enact political and economic reforms. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/08/france-macron-returns-beirut-press-reforms-200831181941308.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 China–India skirmishes]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (India)|Indian defence ministry]] accuses China's [[People's Liberation Army]] of militarising along the [[Line of Actual Control]] near the disputed [[Pangong Tso|Pangong Lake]] in [[Ladakh]]. India claims China had violated the consensus arrived at previous high-level meetings, but the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China|Chinese foreign ministry]] denied the claim with their spokesperson saying, "the Chinese border troops have always strictly abided by the Line of Actual Control and have never crossed the line." [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/asia/india-china-border-intl-hnk-scli/index.html (CNN)] 
*[[Australia–China relations]]
**[[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Australia)|Australian foreign minister]] [[Marise Payne]] confirms that Chinese-born Australian journalist Cheng Lei, an [[News presenter|anchor]] for the [[China Global Television Network]], a [[State media|state-controlled media]] broadcaster, has been detained in [[Beijing]] under "residential surveillance" since August 14. The Chinese foreign ministry has not cited a rationale behind her detention. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/media/cheng-lei-detained-australia-china/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3099619/chinese-born-australian-cgtn-journalist-cheng-lei-detained (''South China Morning Post'')]
**The [[Ministry of Commerce (China)|Chinese commerce ministry]] probes the [[Australian wine]] industry on 40 allegations of violating [[countervailing duties]], following a complaint by the China Wine Industry Association regarding recent wine imports from Australia. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/08/31/business/australia-china-wine-imports-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[China–Czech Republic relations]], [[One-China policy]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Czech Republic)|Czech foreign ministry]] summons the [[Ambassadors of China|Chinese ambassador]] in [[Prague]] over threats made by [[Foreign Minister of the People's Republic of China|Chinese foreign minister]] [[Wang Yi (politician)|Wang Yi]] against [[President of the Senate of the Czech Republic|Senate President]] [[Miloš Vystrčil]], who is on an official visit to [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/czechs-summon-chinese-envoy-over-taiwan-row-13069278 (CNA)]
*[[Russia–Slovakia relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian foreign ministry]] expels three [[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[diplomat]]s from [[Moscow]] in a [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocal move]] after the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Slovakia)|Slovak foreign ministry]] expelled three Russian diplomats from [[Bratislava]] on August 11 for alleged [[espionage]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/politics/russia-expels-3-slovak-diplomats-in-reciprocal-move/1958568 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[France–Turkey relations]], [[European Union–Turkey relations]], [[Aegean dispute]]
**French [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|Foreign Minister]] [[Jean-Yves Le Drian]] calls for a "coordinated European response" to recent Turkish aggression towards [[Greece]] and [[Cyprus]] in the [[Eastern Mediterranean]], saying "Europe needs to leave the age of innocence behind and shape its own destiny". [https://www.ekathimerini.com/256409/article/ekathimerini/news/french-fm-calls-for-coordinated-european-response-to-turkey (Ekathimerini)]
*[[Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[United States Mission to the United Nations|United States]] [[United Nations Security Council veto power|vetoes]] a [[United Nations Security Council resolution]] calling for "the prosecution, rehabilitation, and reintegration" of terrorists. [[List of ambassadors of the United States to the United Nations|Ambassador]] [[Kelly Craft]] attributes the veto to the resolution's exclusion of repatriating [[foreign fighters in the Syrian and Iraqi Civil Wars]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7308143/us-veto-un-anti-terrorism-resolution/ (AP via Global News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Rwanda]]n humanitarian and [[Presidential Medal of Freedom]] recipient [[Paul Rusesabagina]] is shown off in handcuffs at the [[Rwanda Investigation Bureau]] headquarters in [[Kigali]]. The Bureau says he is detained on charges of terrorism, but does not say where or when he was arrested. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/rwanda-rusesabagina-arrest-1.5706082 (CBC)]
*[[Minister for Infrastructure, Transport and Regional Development#List of ministers for urban development and cities|Australian Minister for Population, Cities and Urban Infrastructure]] [[Alan Tudge]] announces that the [[Parliament of Australia|Parliamentary]] [[Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security|Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security]] will probe the alleged interference by foreign governments at [[Tertiary education in Australia|the country's universities]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/08/31/australia-to-probe-foreign-influence-at-universities----------.html (AFP via ''The Jakarta Post'')]
*Lawyers representing the families of the victims of [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 17]] state their intention to seek unspecified [[damages]] from four suspects charged by the [[Openbaar Ministerie|Dutch Public Prosecution Service]] in connection with the incident. The claims have yet to be filed, as a [[Judiciary of the Netherlands#District Courts|Dutch District Court]] shall determine whether [[Law of the Netherlands|Dutch]] or [[Law of Ukraine|Ukrainian law]] would be applied. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/mh17-malaysian-airlines-trial-missile-russia-ukraine-13069326 (CNA)] [https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/families-malaysia-airlines-mh17-victims-want-damages-lawyers-say (VOA)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Disputed [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] [[pardon]]s 110 [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|lawmakers]] and associates of disputed acting President [[Juan Guaidó]]. [[Ministry of Communication and Information (Venezuela)|Communications Minister]] [[Jorge Rodríguez (Venezuelan politician)|Jorge Rodríguez]] says the pardons were made "in the interests of promoting national reconciliation". [https://www.manilatimes.net/2020/09/01/news/latest-stories/venezuelas-maduro-pardons-opposition-lawmakers/762078/ (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[2020 Guinean presidential election]]
**Incumbent [[President of Guinea|President]] [[Alpha Condé]] accepts the nomination of his party, the [[Rally of the Guinean People]], to run in the October election. Condé is allowed to seek a third term under the new constitution passed following a [[2020 Guinean constitutional referendum|referendum]] in March that reset the presidential term limits. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200831-guinea-s-conde-to-run-for-3rd-term-says-ruling-party (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Politics of Lebanon]]
**[[Mustapha Adib (politician)|Mustapha Adib]], the current [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] ambassador to [[Germany]], is designated by [[President of Lebanon|President]] [[Michel Aoun]] as the country's [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|prime minister]] following the resignation of [[Hassan Diab]] and [[Lebanese government of January 2020|his cabinet]] in the wake of the [[2020 Beirut explosion|Beirut explosion]] earlier this month. [https://www.dw.com/en/lebanon-taps-diplomat-mustapha-adib-to-lead-new-government/a-54765106 (DW)]
*[[Politics of Monaco]]
**{{ill|Pierre Dartout|fr}} is sworn in as [[Minister of State (Monaco)|Minister of State]], succeeding [[Serge Telle]]. [https://www.lobservateurdemonaco.mc/infos/politique/pierre-dartout-ceremonie-monaco (''L'Observateur de Monaco'')]
;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[NASA]]’s [[Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite]] discovers [[TOI-824b]], a [[Hot Neptune]] [[exoplanet]] that orbits dwarf star TOI-824, which is located 210 light-years away in the constellation [[Circinus]]. [http://www.sci-news.com/astronomy/toi-824b-rare-hot-neptune-nearby-dwarf-star-08797.html (Sci-News)]
